mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS project_id,p.version AS project_version,p.project_code,p.project_name,p.company_code,p.company_name,p.customer_code,p.customer_name,p.manager_employee_no,p.manager_name, COALESCE(v.scope_version,0) AS scope_version FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN com_delivery_scope_project_version v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.project_id=p.id AND v.deleted=FALSE WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=FALSE AND p.id IN #{id}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,source_evidence FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND LEFT(source_evidence,30)='DPPMS:pm_project_product_line:' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id IN #{id}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM com_delivery_scope_detail WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND delivery_scope_id IN #{key}AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,code,name,version FROM system_dept WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE AND code IS NOT NULL AND code<>''
mapper.sql: JOIN int_base_sync_binding b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.object_key='PRODUCT_SCOPE' AND b.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.task_id AND t.task_code='BASE_P22' AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.deleted=FALSE AND t.active_run_id=b.last_run_id
mapper.update: UPDATE com_delivery_scope s JOIN system_dept d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND CAST(d.code AS BINARY)=CAST(s.department_code AS BINARY) AND d.deleted=FALSE AND d.id>0 AND d.version=s.department_version AND CAST(d.name AS BINARY)=CAST(s.department_name AS BINARY) SET s.department_id=d.id,s.update_time=s.update_time WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.department_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.department_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.department_code)<>''
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_delivery_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.department_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.department_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.department_code)<>''

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='com_delivery_scope' AND column_name IN ('department_code','department_name','department_version') AND is_nullable='YES'

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='com_delivery_scope' AND column_name='order_line_id' AND referenced_table_name IS NOT NULL)=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='com_delivery_scope' AND column_name IN ('order_source_system','order_company_code','order_type') AND is_nullable='YES')=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.sql:
FROM com_sales_order_line l JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND o.id=l.order_id AND o.deleted=FALSE AND o.status='ENABLED' AND CAST(o.source_system AS BINARY)=CAST(l.source_system AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(l.company_code AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.order_type AS BINARY)=CAST(l.order_type AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.order_no AS BINARY)=CAST(l.order_no AS BINARY) JOIN int_base_sync_binding ob ON ob.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND ob.target_id=l.id AND ob.object_key='SALES_LINE' AND ob.deleted=FALSE
AND CAST(ob.source_key AS BINARY)=CAST(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(l.source_system,l.company_code,CAST(l.line_type AS UNSIGNED),l.order_no,l.line_no) AS CHAR),256) AS BINARY) JOIN int_base_sync_task ot ON ot.tenant_id=ob.tenant_id AND ot.id=ob.task_id AND ot.task_code='BASE_P14' AND ot.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND ot.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_run rr ON rr.tenant_id=ot.tenant_id AND rr.task_id=ot.id AND rr.connection_id=ot.connection_id AND rr.id=ob.last_run_id AND rr.task_code='BASE_P14' AND rr.status='COMPLETED' AND rr.preview=FALSE AND rr.deleted=FALSE WHERE l.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND l.deleted=FALSE AND l.status='ENABLED' AND l.source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS')

MIN(l.id) AS id,MAX(l.source_system) AS source_system,MAX(l.company_code) AS company_code,MAX(l.company_name) AS company_name,MAX(l.order_type) AS order_type,MAX(l.order_no) AS order_no,MAX(l.line_no) AS line_no,MAX(l.product_code) AS product_code
GROUP BY CAST(l.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(l.order_no AS BINARY),CAST(l.line_no AS BINARY),CAST(l.product_code AS BINARY) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)=1

UPDATE com_delivery_scope s
STRAIGHT_JOIN (SELECT ) matched ON matched.company_code=s.project_company_code AND matched.order_no=s.order_no AND matched.line_no=s.line_no AND matched.product_code=s.product_code AND CAST(matched.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(s.project_company_code AS BINARY) AND CAST(matched.order_no AS BINARY)=CAST(s.order_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(matched.line_no AS BINARY)=CAST(s.line_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(matched.product_code AS BINARY)=CAST(s.product_code AS BINARY) SET s.order_line_id=matched.id,s.order_source_system=matched.source_system,s.order_company_code=matched.company_code,s.order_company_name=matched.company_name,s.order_type=matched.order_type,s.update_time=s.update_time WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.order_line_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS' AND s.allocation_confirmed=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_delivery_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.order_line_id=-1 AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.allocation_source='DPPMS'
